title: QB Blueprint (Zeptly Registry Protocol v0.1 envelope)
$comment: The common envelope follows the approved Zeptly Registry Protocol v0.1. Deferred by the protocol and NOT defined here: Evidence Protocol ownership/schema, capability/gateway/model namespace ownership, signing, peer-index distribution, workspace overrides, traffic channels, nested QB execution, runtime-trigger contract versioning.
description: Canonical declarative definition of one version of a QB orchestration agent. Pure data: no code, endpoints or secrets.

kind.description: Evolution kinds beyond `refined` are not yet defined.

synthetic.description: true marks fabricated example data. Synthetic artifacts live only under synthetic/ and never enter production indexes.

links.description: Human-facing documentation links. The only place (besides provenance.sources) where URLs are permitted.

agentClass.description: Fixed. QB is an orchestration agent class and is architecturally separate from Zep and from Timesavers.

instructions.description: Canonical system-level operating instructions for the QB. Plain text; treated as data by the runtime.

progressEvents.description: Whether the QB emits structured progress events to the caller.

maxDepth.description: Max nesting of delegation (QB -> agent -> sub-delegation).

nestedQb.description: Nested QB execution is DISABLED and its design is unresolved (cycle detection, budget inheritance). The only permitted value is `forbidden`.

requirePlanArtifact.description: Plan must be persisted as a versioned artifact in run state.

systemOneCritique.description: Ask Jev/System-1 to critique the plan.

requireAcceptanceCriteria.description: Every subtask must carry explicit acceptance criteria.

delegation.description: Delegation targets are referenced by ID and MUST also appear in `dependencies`.

allow.description: Execution Agent ids (registry `execution-agents`); each MUST appear in top-level `references`.

allowCompile.description: May request ad-hoc Tiny Agent compilation from the Tiny Agent compiler.

allowedTemplates.description: Tiny Agent ids (registry `tiny-agents`); each MUST appear in `references`.

allowedSkills.description: Skill ids (registry `skills`); each MUST appear in `references`.

rules.description: Structured routing rules. Deliberately not an expression language: rules are data.

target.description: Registry-local id: an execution-agents id for delegate-execution-agent, a tiny-agents id for compile-tiny-agent.

suite.description: Evaluation suite shipped beside this blueprint (evals/suite.yaml).

jev.description: System-1 (Jev) policy. Jev is reached ONLY via an abstract authenticated AI Gateway contract; blueprints never carry endpoints, hosts, or credentials.

onUnavailable.description: Behaviour when a `required` operation cannot be served.

models.description: Model policy expressed as abstract tiers per role, resolved by the AI Gateway. Concrete model IDs are intentionally not part of canonical definitions.

diversity.description: Require evaluator role to differ from generating model family where the gateway can.

handoff.description: What may flow from the QB to delegated agents.

rollback.description: Rollback creates a new branch in the lineage; history is never rewritten.

requiresHitlAbove.description: Swarm size above which human approval is required.

softLimitRatio.description: Fraction of a hard limit at which budget-pressure fires.

callerOverride.description: Whether callers may lower (never raise) budgets per run.

capabilities.description: Least-privilege capability permissions. Default is deny; every allowed ID must appear in `dependencies`.

runStateSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the QB's run-state extension fields.

evidence.description: Evidence-emission contract the runtime MUST honour when executing this blueprint. Raw evidence never lives in Git.

selfModification.description: A QB never rewrites or deploys its own canonical definition. Improvements arrive only via Git PR.

contract.description: Runtime interpretation contract the blueprint targets. Executed by a runtime such as Trigger.dev; never named here.

breaking.description: Human-readable breaking changes relative to provenance.parent.

extensions.description: Namespaced escape hatch for runtime-specific hints. Linted for secrets and URLs; never authoritative.

spec.description: QB-specific semantics (unchanged from the candidate architecture): decomposition, delegation, replanning, budgets, concurrency, escalation, HITL, evaluation, Jev policy, checkpointing, swarm.

references.description: Structured cross-registry references {registry, id, version, digest?}. Single declaration table for skills / tiny-agents / execution-agents / qb-agents used by `spec`.

externalSources.description: Human-facing citations. URLs are permitted only here and in metadata.links.

capabilities.description: Capability tokens this artifact requests. MUST equal the set in spec.capabilities.allow; never silently altered by a compiler or runtime.

attestations.description: Digest-bound assessments. Every attestation MUST bind to this artifact's exact current digest; a stale subjectDigest fails validation.

schema.description: Inline JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) describing the payload.
